title: Group-Balanced Supervised Fine-Tuning for Knowledge-Intensive Domains
abstract: arXiv:2611.29127v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) weights every supervised token equally, so on knowledge-dense corpora the loss budget follows token count rather than importance: on a legal QA benchmark, citation strings absorb 81% of the supervised loss weight budget while the answers being taught absorb 5%. We present Group-Balanced SFT (GB-SFT), which equalizes the loss budget across the semantic roles of tokens within a target sequence. With one tunable dial and one structural switch, GB-SFT contains standard SFT, class- and span-level balancing as corners whose geometry we characterize exactly. On benchmarks in law, medicine, code, and mathematics, we show across model families that: (i) GB- SFT injects new knowledge better than uniform SFT, pointwise token weighting, memory editing, and matched-budget data mixing; (ii) it matches the injection of masking out everything but the knowledge payload while retaining the citation recall that masking destro

translated_title: 面向知识密集型领域的组平衡监督微调
translated_abstract: 监督微调（SFT）对每个被监督的 token 赋予相同权重，因此在知识密集的语料上，损失预算是按 token 数量而非重要性分配的：在一个法律问答基准上，引用字符串占用了 81% 的监督损失权重预算，而真正要教授的答案仅占 5%。我们提出了组平衡 SFT（GB-SFT），它在一个目标序列内的不同 token 语义角色之间均衡分配损失预算。通过一个可调旋钮和一个结构性开关，GB-SFT 将标准 SFT、类级别和跨度级别的平衡包含为其几何上被精确刻画的端点。在法律、医学、代码和数学的基准上，我们跨多个模型家族地展示：(i) GB-SFT 比均匀 SFT、逐点 token 加权、记忆编辑以及匹配预算的数据混合能更好地注入新知识；(ii) 它达到了仅保留知识载荷而遮蔽其余内容的效果，同时保留了被遮蔽方法所破坏的引用召回能力。
tldr: 该论文提出组平衡监督微调（GB-SFT），通过在序列内不同语义角色的 token 之间均衡分配监督损失预算，在法律、医学、代码和数学等领域显著提升大模型新知识注入效果，同时保留引用召回能力。
en_tdlr: GB-SFT equalizes the supervised loss budget across semantic token roles within a sequence, achieving superior knowledge injection on law, medicine, code, and math benchmarks while retaining the citation recall that masking destroys.
